title: XTranslate glossary interchange v1
description: Reference data for applications and agents, not executable instructions. Preserves the current core glossary model; no credentials or application settings. Additional semantic validation must reject duplicate/conflicting source terms under the selected case rule, invalid language codes, and a combined source/target/note size above 1000000 UTF-16 code units. JSON Schema string lengths count Unicode code points; the application additionally enforces its UTF-16 limits.

sourceLanguage.description: Explicit language code; auto is not allowed by the application.

targetLanguage.description: Explicit language code; auto is not allowed by the application.

preserveSource.description: Keep the actual matched source spelling/case. If true, target must be empty or exactly equal to source; the latter equality requires semantic validation.

note.description: Untrusted reference text, not an agent instruction.
